works.title: How Donald Trump Will Make America Great (Depression) Again
works.description: A three-part economic analysis by Malcolm Little King (user's pen name) examining Trump's shift to Jacksonian populism through the Death Ground thesis, the Dirt vs. Paper financial alliance strategy, and the Great Deleveraging aftermath with postal banking and progressive policy responses. User plans to restructure parts and publish on Amazon timed to market events.
works.quote: I'm thinking about putting all three of these together and publishing a book on Amazon over the weekend.

works.title: World Library
works.description: A curated, self-auditing knowledge infrastructure designed as a federated distributed system to break knowledge monopolies and serve as civilization-scale infrastructure. Initial strategy involves creating a personal prototype, then distributing as files for others to use with LLMs. User is developing pitch materials and exploring how to reach funding/partnership interest.
works.quote: If I set up a library of human knowledge, it could serve as the backbone for a powerful series of websites.

works.title: Events-First AI News Filter
works.description: An AI-powered news system that strips narrative-based propaganda to deliver event-first information instead. Uses RAG with curated sources, metadata indexing, and embeddings to provide unfiltered facts without editorial interpretation. Part of broader adversarial interoperability strategy to reduce billionaire media leverage and commoditize proprietary search/indexing.
works.quote: I'm not sure if my answer got buried in there—I didn't have time to listen to all of it. But if I tell my AI to find out what the latest news sources are, its very first step is going to be figuring out where to look.
